According to California Highway Patrol, the accident happened at 7:34 a.m. at the intersection of Murphy Road and San Juan Road. Police confirmed that two vehicles collided with each other, one unidentified and one identified as a white pickup truck. Paramedics and numerous other responders were called to the scene. When they arrived, they discovered one or more parties with injuries. Parties were checked on scene and then taken to local hospitals for treatment. No further details have been released. The investigation into the collision continues. Offering Support to Victims of Monterey Car Accidents Being injured in a car accident can turn your life upside-down in the blink of an eye. The injuries from these accidents can be long-lasting, painful, and keep you from working and enjoying your hobbies for some time. You could be in a difficult predicament as you question how you will pay the bills after your accident. Speaking with an attorney is one of the best ways to get back on your feet. If you choose to move forward with a personal injury claim, you may discover that you’re eligible for some of the following types of damages: Medical and therapy expenses Loss of income due to missed time at work Pain and suffering damages Punitive damages in cases of gross negligence Loss of enjoyment of life It is imperative that you act quickly to retain your rights after an accident. In California, the statute of limitations is two years from the time you become injured. After that, you could miss out on financial opportunities. Contact a Monterey Car Accident Lawyer At Maison Law, our Monterey car accident lawyers are here for you after you’ve been injured in a serious collision. We understand how overwhelming an accident can be and that you likely have a variety of questions. Our attorneys will provide you with the resources you need to endure negotiations with the insurance companies and work toward the settlement you need. If you were hurt in a car accident, never delay seeking help. Please contact us today for a no-obligation legal consultation that comes with no upfront costs.
